name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
education_requirement: Above 80th percentile in Class 12 and pursuing regular degree course
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per annum for graduation (first 3 years) and Rs. 20,000 per annum for post-graduation.

eligibility_rules.description: Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000.
Must be pursuing a regular higher education degree course.
Must be currently studying as a regular student.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A Central Sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and domestic needs.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a landholding farmer family.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: An initiative by AICTE to empower girl students by providing financial assistance to pursue technical education (Degree or Diploma) in recognized institutions.
education_requirement: Admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma course or 2nd year via lateral entry
required_documents: Declaration of single/two girl child status
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum for course duration as a lump sum amount for college fee, computer purchase, books, etc.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a female student.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000.
Must be studying in an AICTE-approved institution.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides micro-finance and collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and self-employed individuals.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
benefits: Collateral-free business loans under 3 categories: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (Rs. 50,000 - 5 Lakh), Tarun (Rs. 5 Lakh - 10 Lakh).

eligibility_rules.description: Must be an entrepreneur or non-farm small business owner.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Provides monthly financial assistance to eligible women in Maharashtra to foster economic independence and self-reliance.
benefits: Rs. 1,500 per month transferred directly to the woman beneficiary's bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a resident of Maharashtra.
Must be female.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (Maharashtra)
description: Provides 50% tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement to economically backward class (EBC) students in Maharashtra pursuing professional and higher education.
education_requirement: Admitted through CAP round in Diploma/Degree/Postgraduate professional courses
required_documents: Family Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
benefits: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000.
Must be currently enrolled in higher education in Maharashtra.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Karnataka)
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students residing in Karnataka who are pursuing post-matric studies.
education_requirement: Class 10 completed, pursuing post-matric courses (Class 11, Diploma, Degree, or PG)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees, admission fees, and monthly maintenance allowance.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
Must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be currently enrolled in a post-matric course.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (Karnataka)
description: Provides tuition fee concession and maintenance allowance to OBC category students in Karnataka pursuing post-matric courses.
required_documents: Caste and Income Certificate (RD number verified)
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
benefits: Tuition fee concession and monthly maintenance allowance.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
Must belong to OBC category.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be currently studying in a post-matric course.

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
description: Financial assistance scheme to promote education and welfare of girl children born in Delhi.
education_requirement: Enrolled in recognized school in Delhi
benefits: Financial deposit up to Rs. 1,00,000 accumulated upon reaching 18 years of age and passing Class 10/12.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a resident of Delhi.
Must be a girl child.
Family income must not exceed Rs. 1,00,000 per year.

name: UP Post Matric Scholarship Scheme (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Scholarship and fee reimbursement scheme for General, OBC, SC, ST, and Minority students in Uttar Pradesh pursuing post-matric courses.
education_requirement: Enrolled in Class 11, 12, Diploma, Graduation, or PG in UP
required_documents: Income Certificate verified on UP Portal
benefits: 100% Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Monthly Maintenance Allowance.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be pursuing post-matric studies in UP.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana - MYSY (Gujarat)
description: Financial assistance to bright students from Gujarat pursuing Higher Education courses like Engineering, Pharmacy, Medical, Diploma, etc.
education_requirement: Scored 80% or above in Class 10/12 and pursuing Higher Education
required_documents: Hostel Fee Receipt (if staying in hostel)
benefits: 50% of tuition fee (up to Rs. 2,00,000 for MBBS, Rs. 50,000 for Engg), plus Rs. 12,000/yr hostel allowance.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a resident of Gujarat.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 6,00,000.
Must be studying in higher education in Gujarat.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: End-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades like carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, etc.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, Basic Training stipend (Rs. 500/day), Toolkit Incentive of Rs. 15,000, and collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be engaged in one of 18 traditional family-based trades.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
description: Provides monthly basic income support to women heads of eligible households across Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Direct monthly cash benefit of Rs. 1,000 credited to the woman's bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
Must be female.
Annual family income must be less than Rs. 2,50,000.

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
description: Top Class School and College Education Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students.
education_requirement: Studying in Class 9 to Class 12 or Top Class College
benefits: Rs. 75,000/yr for Class 9-10; Rs. 1,25,000/yr for Class 11-12.

eligibility_rules.description: Must belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT categories.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be a regular student.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Provides financial support to students with disabilities to enable them to pursue post-matric or post-secondary courses.
benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance, book grant, and tuition fee reimbursement.

eligibility_rules.description: Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be pursuing a post-matric course.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakhs and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Bank loans from Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore covering up to 75% of project cost with reduced margin money.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.
